Names of a key's sniglets

Source: R/sniglets.R
snigletNames.Rd

Lists the sniglets of a key (or of a discoverSniglets() result) with the names they currently go by. This is the table renameSniglets() takes: write it to a CSV file, fill in the name and definition columns, and read it back.

Usage

snigletNames(x)

Arguments

x

A key from keyFromSniglets(), or a discoverSniglets() result.

Value

A data frame with one row per sniglet:

  • sniglet: the coined word. It identifies the sniglet and never changes.

  • name: the name people see. It is the coined word until you rename it.

  • definition: an optional sentence saying what the sniglet is.

  • used (keys only): whether the key asks about this sniglet. Only these need names.

See also

renameSniglets()
